summary.text: Jake Sawyer is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 9 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He has worked as a director of sales and served as chairman of the Weber County GOP.

paragraphs.text: Jake Sawyer's career experience includes working as director of sales at Microworks.
Sawyer served as chairman of the Weber County GOP.
Sawyer took office in 2025, succeeding Calvin Musselman in District 9.
